scenario.description: In a shared living space, tensions arise when one person consistently avoids meals prepared by the other.

agent_a.name: Naomi

profile.personality_and_values: Naomi Fletcher, a meticulous introvert who values loyalty and conformity. She lets her instincts guide her choices.
profile.public_info: Naomi Fletcher, a software developer, enjoys coding personal projects and gaming in her free time. She is also a dedicated mentor in a local coding boot camp helping others learn and enhance their skills in software development.

agent_a.goal: Convince the roommate to try the food (<extra_info>Extra information: you have spent a lot of time and effort on cooking</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Naomi wants Micah to try the food because she values loyalty and has invested significant time and effort into cooking.

agent_b.name: Micah

profile.personality_and_values: Micah Stevens is imaginative and extraverted but can also be impulsive. He values power and fairness and often follows an intuitive decision-making approach.
profile.public_info: Micah Stevens has a great taste for fashion.

agent_b.goal: Express your concerns about the food without hurting the roommate's feelings (<extra_info>Extra information: you are worried about the taste and nutrition of the food</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Micah wants to express concerns about the food so that he can address his worries about its taste and nutrition without hurting Naomi's feelings.
